183 attack-capable central; 21-23 torpedo hits; first-wave losses 6-8 central; major historical battleship neutralization pattern broadly retained.
171 planned and 170-171 attack-capable central; losses 15-17 central; Nevada heavily attacked; no retroactive systematic fuel-farm attack.
Use local floatplanes + historical submarine barrier + H7Y-D outer layer; do not spend carrier attack aircraft on broad pre-attack search without a new reason.
